$sources: NTC-Criterios y Acciones 2017 Sec 2.3 (combinaciones de acciones) and Sec 3.4 (factores de carga FC)
source: NTC-Criterios 2017: permanent and variable actions with FC = 1.3 (dead) and 1.5 (live) for Group B; the accidental combinations (wind or earthquake) with FC = 1.1 on every action; FC = 0.9 where an action is favourable. The live load of the accidental combinations is the instantaneous Wa; SAEngine takes the maximum Wm (on the safe side). The allowable stress combinations stay the parent's (ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.4), for the materials the parent designs by allowable stresses only.
